content:
maya: Spinning up a new GKE cluster in eu-west3 for the ML infra playground. Goal: 2 GPU nodepools (A100 + T4) private cluster, VPC-native. Starting a quick preflight thread for validation and handoff.

leo: Nice. Quick checklist: quota for A100 in eu-west3? subnet IPs, shared VPC perms, and VPC-SC constraints.

anika: Also remember GKE regional control plane vs zonal differences for private clusters. We prefer regional for HA.

sam: I'll run quota checks. For A100 we need GPU quota+GPUs per zone. Running: `gcloud compute regions describe eu-west3 --project=redwood-prod` then `gcloud compute quotas list --region=eu-west3`

sam: Found limits: GPUs available: 8 A100, 32 T4 across region. That fits initial capacity but we should request bump for growth.

maya: Good call. Notes for nodepool config: taints for batch workloads, labels `node.kubernetes.io/role=gpu`, `gpu-type=a100|t4`, autoscaling min/max, and image `cos_containerd` with NVIDIA drivers.

leo: For drivers we use GKE's GPU driver installation daemonset? Prefer image-based node-driver-install to avoid init delays. Add the metadata flag `enable-gpu-driver` on nodepool create to let GKE install drivers automatically.

anika: Add-ons: enable `cloud-run`? no. Must ensure `metrics-server`, `cluster-autoscaler`, `nvidia-device-plugin` are deployed in kube-system. Also `node-problem-detector` for GPU health.

sam: Quick create snippet I'm testing:```bash
gcloud container clusters create redwood-eu-wk1 \
  --region=eu-west3 \
  --private-cluster \
  --enable-master-authorized-networks \
  --enable-ip-alias \
  --enable-autorepair \
  --enable-shielded-nodes \
  --project=redwood-prod

# then nodepool
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-a100-pool \
  --cluster=redwood-eu-wk1 \
  --region=eu-west3 \
  --machine-type=n1-standard-16 \
  --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 \
  --num-nodes=2 \
  --min-nodes=1 --max-nodes=8 \
  --node-taints=gpu=true:NoSchedule \
  --node-labels=node.kubernetes.io/role=gpu,gpu-type=a100 \
  --image-type=COS_CONTAINERD \
  --enable-autoupgrade \
  --enable-autorepair 
```

leo: Cool. After nodepool comes driver validation: `kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep nvidia` and verify `nvidia-smi` from a debug pod. Also ensure GPU topology manager feature gates are compatible with our runtime.

maya: Networking validation: private cluster needs private endpoints set and a dedicated subnet with /19 for node IPs. Confirm DNS peering and hub/spoke routes for egress to internal artifact registry.

anika: IAM/Workload Identity: bind the GKE node service account to the needed KMS and storage roles. Document the least-priv perms for the node SA in the handoff.

sam: Cost note: A100 ~x$/hr (prod pricing) — add a cost-center tag and label so billing export can attribute to `ml-playground`. We'll set cluster labels: `env=dev`, `team=ml-platform`, `cost-center=ml-playground`.

maya: Handoff checklist to infra-run team (short):
- Confirm GPU quotas and request increases (provide request link)
- VPC subnet created and route tables validated
- Private cluster control plane IPs allocated
- Node pools created with taints/labels and autoscaler configured
- Deploy NVIDIA device plugin + metrics-server + node-problem-detector
- Run sample GPU job and collect `nvidia-smi` output
- Configure logging (Cloud Logging) and alerting for GPU OOM, node eviction rates
- Billing label verification and tag export

leo: I'll add a small validation job YAML and post it here. Use `kubectl run gpu-check --image=nvidia/cuda:11.4-base --limits='nvidia.com/gpu:1' -- sleep 3600` then exec `nvidia-smi`.

anika: Also add e2e step to verify autoscaler: create a job that requests GPUs to force scale-up and measure time-to-schedule. Record baseline latency for onboarding docs.

deploy-bot: Cluster creation triggered: redwood-eu-wk1 (eu-west3) by maya — status: provisioning.

infra-bot: Reminder: open change request for firewall rules and NAT gateways before exposing egress from private nodes.

maya: Thanks y'all. I'll finish the gcloud script, push to infra repo, and tag you for the validation run. Will attach the driver-check logs here once done. :thumbsup:

leo: Ping me when ready, will run the autoscaler validation and quota follow-ups.

anika: I'll draft the handoff doc and include a one-page runbook for on-call.

sam: Leaving a note to request +16 A100 quota to EU-WEST3 support queue now.

maya: End of thread — will update last message with logs.
